chunks: Verily those who fear God think of Him when assailed by the instigations of Satan, and lo! they begin to understand,
ai.seo_question: How do the God-fearing respond to Satan's whispers?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the immediate spiritual reflex of the *al-muttaqun*, where divine remembrance (*dhikr*) acts as a cognitive reset, transforming confusion into clear insight (*mubsiroon*). This mechanism underscores the practical application of *taqwa* not merely as piety, but as an active defense against the subtle distractions of Satan, a concept further elaborated in the traditions of the Ahl al-Bayt regarding the purification of the heart.
